messages:
meera: quick follow-up from the policy RFC — we need to land a concrete plan for the validator + compact telemetry for routing decisions. can we sync on constraints and deployment flow?

alex: +1. my take: validator should catch hard incompatibilities (e.g., fallback to a model that doesn't support kv-cache) and surface soft warnings (cost/latency mismatches). telemetry needs to be one-line-per-decision for high-qps tenants.

meera: thinking of adding a 'dry-lint' stage to the policy CI pipeline: runs lint + sample-sim and emits a degen score. dry-lint would be optional but recommended for tenants touching region/tier rules. avoids blocking fast rollouts while giving signal.

tj: I like dry-lint, but ops concern: it adds time. proposal: run dry-lint async in CI -> if score > threshold, mark commit as "risky" and gate canary rollout with auto-rollback threshold. non-blocking by default. :thinking_face:

infra-bot: deploybot: dry-lint job queued for commit abc123 (PR #412). logs: https://ci/internal/412/logs

rachel: ops note: for region-aware fallbacks we must include region, chosen_variant, and reason_code in the audit entry. but do NOT emit full policy blobs per request (would blow up). compact lines only. also need retention plan (30d hot, 365d cold).

alex: suggested compact telemetry schema (TSV):
```
ts\trequest_id\ttenant\troute\tchosen_variant\treason_code\tlatency_ms\tcost_units\tdegen_score
2026-03-22T15:04:02Z\treq-9a1b\tacme\t/complete\tm-7q\tFALLBACK_SLA\t42\t0.12\t0.77
```
this keeps logs narrow and parseable. we can gzip and ship to s3/pubsub.

meera: runtime change: add an optional response field "validation_hint" so decision path can carry a short tag for replay/queries. small string (enum-like) not full policy. that will let us reconcile telemetry <-> policy versions.

tj: agree. validation_hint should be stable and short, e.g., "fallback_quant_mismatch". runtime should not block on it but include when present.

rachel: action item from ops: ensure telemetry lines have tenant_id hashed for PII if requested by customer, and expose sampling controls per-tenant. also need a backpressure plan if telemetry spikes.

alex: edge-case: mixing quantized/unquantized variants across fallback chain. validator: allow with a soft-warning unless the runtime indicates incompatible cache behavior. add rule: if variants differ in kv-cache semantics -> hard fail.

meera: agreed. summarizing action items: 1) meera -> PR for dry-lint pipeline + degen scoring (due Tue) 2) alex -> telemetry spec + example -> proto + ingestion mapping (due Tue) 3) tj -> runtime hint field + backward-compat plan (due Fri) 4) rachel -> ops retention/sampling/backpressure doc (due Wed)

alex: +1 on owners. can we also add a small simulation job that replays 1% of production traffic against new policy in sandbox? low-cost but high-signal.

meera: yes, add simulation as follow-up once dry-lint exists. small sample first.

tj: ok. thanks all. :thumbsup:

rachel: noted, I'll slot retention in next oncall-runbook update.

meera: closing loop — if no objections by EOD I'll open the PRs and the CSV telemetry schema will be our baseline.

alex: no objections. go for it. :rocket:
